{{Quote|Would you&hellip;''"<br />"''Take you there? Give you a place there? Of course. I think that is truly the reason I was drawn here tonight. You belong there.|Kirasha and Darrus Jeht|<ref name="Reprieves" />}} 
'''Kirasha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] follower of the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[The Force|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Kirasha was assigned by the Wyrd to discover the cause of a drain in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] strength of the [[Tarasin]] leader [[Dariana]], an enemy of the witches. While conducting her investigation, Kirasha received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of a [[Great Plan (location)|shelter]] for [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals concealed beneath the [[Spirit Tree (Cularin)|Spirit Tree]], the largest of Cularin's [[ch'hala tree]]s. After coming to from her vision, Kirasha was confronted by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] spared Kirasha's life and she accepted an offer to accompany him to the hiding place beneath the Spirit [[Tree/Legends|Tree]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You saw it, didn't you?|Darrus Jeht, to Kirasha, on the shelter for Force-sensitives beneath the Spirit Tree|<ref name="Reprieves" />}} 
Kirasha was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At one [[Time/Legends|time]] she considered the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of Cularin to be her home, but at a young age Kirasha lost her family and came to live at a foster residence in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]]. Kirasha was teased by the other [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in the home and at some point she [[Death/Legends|murdered]] her foster family. Afterward, she left to become an adept of the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Tarasin]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-wielding [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] active on Cularin.<ref name="Reprieves" />

Years after the murder of Kirasha's foster family,<ref name="Reprieves" /> in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set [[31 BBY/Legends|one year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward [[21 BBY/Legends|ten years]] to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] had elapsed since the events of ''Below the Belt Philology'', "[[Reprieves]]" can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the leader of the Wyrd [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] a sudden weakening in the Force strength of the followers [[Dariana]], the [[Mother (title)/Legends|matriarch]] of the [[Tarasin]] [[Hiironi irstat]] and an enemy of the Wyrd. Kirasha was selected by the Wyrd leader to investigate the cause of the drain in Dariana's [[Force power/Legends|power]], in hope that this knowledge could be used to bring about Dariana's demise.<ref name="Reprieves" />

For four [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Kirasha searched holy sites of the Hiironi and the other Tarasin [[Irstat|tribes]] in the jungles of Cularin for any clues. However, she found all the places she visited to be either abandoned or barely used and was unable to learn anything useful. Kirasha was brought close to despair by her failure, but eventually she sighted some fresh tracks near to a remote Hiironi irstat ceremony circle. Amid a downpour of [[Water/Legends|rain]], she [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] to learn more about what had caused the tracks. Deep in contemplation, she had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of a trail leading through the jungle to the [[Spirit Tree (Cularin)|Spirit Tree]], the largest of Cularin's [[ch'hala tree]]s, where dozens of Force-sensitive individuals were hidden in a [[Great Plan (location)|concealed chamber]].<ref name="Reprieves" />

While Kirasha meditated, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] came across her. Recognizing her as a member of the Wyrd, Jeht planned to kill her, but found himself unable to go through with the deed and Kirasha came to from her vision to notice Jeht standing over her. She wept and begged him to take her life, so as to end the pain that she felt for causing the deaths of her foster family. Jeht sensed her troubles and that she had been drawn closer to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] than at any time in her life previously. He spared her and offered to take her to the [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] that she had sensed and give her a place there. She accepted and walked with Jeht through the jungle to the hiding place, casting out the ways of the Wyrd from her mind as she went.<ref name="Reprieves" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do it.''"<br />"''No I can't. Why?''"<br />"''I do not know.|Kirasha and Darrus Jeht, on her request that he take her life.|<ref name="Reprieves" />}}
Steadfast in her support of the Wyrd, Kirasha considered the witches to be the strongest people in jungles of Cularin because they had cast aside the old traditions of the Tarasin and took from those who were weak. She also perceived that the Wyrd had grown in power, despite having have suffered multiple setbacks and accepted this as proof of witches' right to dominance on Cularin. Kirasha also thought that with age weakening the elderly Dariana and an [[Clone Wars/Legends|on-going war]] over-stretching the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Wyrd's other main rival group, the witch coven would eventually gain control of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Reprieves" />

Kirasha was independent and felt resentment if she became beholden to anyone or anything. She felt honored that the leader of the Wyrd had chosen her to investigate the weakening in the strength of Dariana's followers and was determined not to return in defeat. She also hoped that the mission would provide her with an opportunity to kill Dariana and to end the threat that she posed to the Wyrd once and for all.<ref name="Reprieves" />

Though she did not feel remorse in the immediate aftermath of murdering her foster family, Kirasha was deeply troubled by their deaths and for years afterward felt self-loathing and regret for her transgression. She disliked meditation as the silent introspection brought back memories of her role in the death of her foster family. When she meditated while on the mission to identify the reduction in strength of the followers of Dariana, Kirasha's memories of the event resurfaced, leaving her feeling so wretched and uncertain that she begged Darrus Jeht to kill her.<ref name="Reprieves" />

Kirasha had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on her neck. During her mission to investigate the reduction in strength of the followers of Dariana, she wore a tight [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Clothing/Legends|suit]].<ref name="Reprieves" />

==Powers and abilities==
Kirasha was a skilled tracker. She could use the Force and her powers increased in strength during her time with the Wyrd. She was familiar with the use of meditation to bring about Force visions.<ref name="Reprieves" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kirasha was created by [[August Hahn|August]] and [[Cynthia Hahn]] and appeared in "[[Reprieves]]", a short story published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[January 13]], [[2005]] as a tie-in to [[RPGA]]'s ''[[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign. Kirasha's redemption by Darrus Jeht served to illustrate a new game mechanic in the ''Living Force'' campaign whereby player characters who had received role-playing penalties for previous unethical actions were absolved of those handicaps.<ref name="Reprieves" />

The short story is unclear about the identity of the Wyrd leader who dispatched Kirasha on her mission to search for the cause of the weakening in the strength of Dariana.<ref name="Reprieves" /> Other sources identify the witch [[Liriana]]<ref name="LDFWOF">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010913a_witch&c=swlfc|text=Liriana: Dark Force Witch of Cularin}}</ref> and an unnamed [[First Witch of the Wyrd]] as the leaders of the coven<ref name="APOD">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness}}</ref> and it was unclear which of these individuals gave Kirasha her orders.<ref name="Reprieves" />
